{"entries":[{"name":"清","reading":"きよ","category":"character","keys":["清","清《きよ》"],"content":"Kiyo is an old maidservant (下女) who has served the narrator's family for ten years. {"entries":[{"name":"清","reading":"きよ","category":"character","keys":["清"],"content":"Kiyo is an old maidservant (下女) who has served the narrator's family for ten years. {"entries":[{"name":"赤シャツ","reading":"あかシャツ","category":"character","keys":["赤シャツ","教頭","文学士"],"content":"Akashatsu is the vice-principal (教頭) of the school, a 文学士 (Bachelor of Arts) from the university, whose surname is not yet given. He has an unusually soft, womanlike voice and wears red flannel underwear even in the summer heat, which the narrator finds ridiculous. He claims the red is good for his health, and the narrator thinks he mocks people by dressing this way. He laughs with a loud ホホホホ, and when the narrator admits he once lost a large carp, he boasts of teaching fishing and invites the narrator to go fishing with him and 吉川. On the boat trip he praises the view and the pine trees, comparing a pine to a painting by Turner, and he objects when the narrator asks about landing on the rock of 青嶋. When the narrator says he plans to negotiate with 山嵐 (堀田), Akashatsu panics, denies promising Horita anything, and warns the narrator against making trouble, which the narrator finds odd. Later, sweating, he asks the narrator to keep the matter of the previous day to himself as a private reference and not to speak of it outside, and the narrator agrees, saying he would be in trouble too. Akashatsu presses him with 君大丈夫かい, and the narrator finds his unreasonable requests illogical and suspects him of distrust, but insists he is a man who would never go back on a promise. The narrator dislikes his arrogance and his cover of superiority, and suspects he wants to show off his skill, but he stays silent rather than debate him because he believes Akashatsu is good at argument."}]}

{"entries":[{"name":"羽柴壮一","reading":"はしばそういち","category":"character","keys":["羽柴壮一","壮一君","壮一"],"content":"The eldest son of 羽柴壮太郎, a born adventurer who left home about ten years earlier without permission to seek a new life in the South Seas. {"entries":[{"name":"二十面相","reading":"にじゅうめんそう","category":"character","keys":["二十面相","「二十面相」","怪盗","怪賊","盗賊","怪青年","忍術使い"],"content":"A notorious thief who sent a threatening letter to 羽柴壮太郎 announcing that he would take the six great diamonds without payment.
